name: Where To Fly
summary: Forecasts, RASP soaring data and paragliding values for flying sites, on the web and as an app.

name: Paragliding Map
summary: A world map of flying sites with a forecast for each.

name: Paraglidable
summary: An experimental forecast that uses AI to estimate how suitable each coming day is for flying and for cross-country. Covers Europe; it showed nothing for Australia or New Zealand when we checked. Free; run by one pilot in France.

name: FreeFlightWx
summary: Live readings from weather stations at flying sites around Australia.

name: Holfuy
summary: Weather stations with live wind readings and webcams at flying sites worldwide.

name: Australian National Site Guide
summary: The national guide to Australian flying sites, with site rules and contacts.

name: ParaglidingEarth
summary: A worldwide database of flying sites, kept up by pilots.

name: XC Atlas
summary: A map for exploring launch sites around the world.

name: Paraglidable v2
summary: Maps of where pilots actually fly, built from GPS tracks, and where thermals are likely. From the maker of Paraglidable; covers Europe, with nothing yet for Australia when we checked.

name: XContest
summary: The online cross-country contest where pilots upload their flights; anyone can browse them by country and site.

name: Australian PPG XContest
summary: XContest's cross-country league for paramotor pilots in Australia.

name: AirCheck
summary: Shows Australian airspace with your flight's altitude, and offers airspace files to download. Free.

name: Paralog
summary: An online flight logbook with 3D replays, a heatmap of your tracks, statistics and badges. Free, with no ads.

name: XC Mag travel guide
summary: Destination guides for free flight, by continent and by the best months to go. Some articles need a subscription.

name: Cloudbase Mayhem (forecasting episodes)
summary: A podcast of interviews with pilots; this page gathers the episodes on forecasting.

name: Skysailor
summary: SAFA's magazine for Australian pilots, with recent issues online.
